name: Nightly dependency review
instructions:
You are running unattended as automation "{{automation.name}}" (trigger: {{trigger.kind}}, catch-up missed fires: {{catchup.missed_count}}).

List open dependabot / renovate pull requests with `gh pr list`. For each one whose checks pass, read the diff. If the bump is a patch or minor version with no breaking-change notes, approve and merge it with `gh pr merge --squash`. Otherwise leave a short comment explaining what needs a human.

Finish with a summary of what you merged and what you skipped.
